narrative: On the almanack. The penny almanac open on the hall table. The three lines of his own hand. No pen. On the almanack. The leaf turned. The printed month, and no stroke of a pen under it. A thumb holds the corner. On the almanack. The marked leaf again. The hand has not taken a pen from anywhere. The three lines are as they were.
